subject: Business Models
title: API Platforms
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: API Platforms.

hook.text: Stripe lets any developer accept payments with a few lines of code. It's a platform for money.

buildup.text: API platforms provide infrastructure as a service. Developers build on top; the platform handles complexity.

discovery.text: Twilio (communications), Stripe (payments), and Plaid (banking data) are invisible layers powering millions of apps.

twist.text: Once embedded, API platforms are almost impossible to rip out. Switching costs are enormous.

climax.text: API platforms profit from the success of every app built on them. They're the picks and shovels.

punchline.text: Build the layer everyone needs. Let others build on top of you.

quiz.question: Why are API platforms hard to displace once adopted?
